notes: This task involves modifying the core logic of the planner to handle execution failures dynamically, which requires careful design to ensure backward compatibility and maintain existing functionalities.

steps.description: Research existing planner logic for handling execution failures
steps.details: Review the current implementation of the planner to understand how it processes execution failures and identify areas where adaptive logic can be integrated.

steps.description: Design adaptive logic for handling failed run_command steps
steps.details: Create a detailed design document outlining the logic for analyzing failed run_command steps and adapting the plan. Include decision-making criteria for modifying or replacing steps, and strategies to prevent identical plans across revisions.

steps.description: Implement adaptive logic in the planner codebase
steps.details: Modify the planner's code to integrate the adaptive logic designed in the previous step. Ensure that the planner can analyze execution failures and adapt plans by modifying or replacing failed run_command steps.

steps.description: Develop mechanism to prevent identical plans across revisions
steps.details: Implement a mechanism within the planner to track and compare previous plans, ensuring that identical plans are not generated across revisions. This may involve storing a history of plans and implementing checks before generating a new plan.

steps.description: Write unit tests for adaptive logic and plan uniqueness
steps.details: Create unit tests to verify that the planner correctly adapts plans based on execution failures and does not generate identical plans across revisions. Ensure tests cover various scenarios and edge cases.

steps.description: Run tests to validate new planner functionalities
steps.details: Execute the unit tests to ensure that the new adaptive logic and plan uniqueness mechanisms work as intended. Verify that the planner maintains its original functionality without regression issues.

steps.description: Document changes and update planner documentation
steps.details: Update the planner's documentation to include information about the new adaptive logic and mechanisms to prevent identical plans. Ensure the documentation is clear and provides guidance on how the new features work.
